$comment: An example world setting (ADR 0074 B4), never a world's own: terrain.json's elevation with the archipelago's knobs, many small islands in a shallow sea. The island's coast capped near the shore and broken by a broad noise (`islands`), a shallow shelf (`seaFloor`), a gentle rise inland. Tests build it by data alone (FIXTURE_WORLDS, WorldMap::for_height); Chisel offers it as a preset. Prototype content.
name: test:archipelago
